name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters II: Dark Duel Stories Game Guide 2 promotional card

printings.name: Left Arm of the Forbidden One

notes: Single-card promo ("Left Arm of the Forbidden One") bundled with the second DM2 strategy guide book. NOTE: the prior research gate's chronology listed a "V-Jump Books DM2 promo" dated 1999-07-13; no such product was located under that description during this certification, and this Game Guide 2 promo (August 5, sourced directly to Yugipedia's product infobox) is the actual next dated Duel Monsters II guide-book promo after Game Guide 1. The corrected date is still before the 1999-08-25 cutoff, so this does not change pool membership.
